behaviors.open-percentage-calculator: The Percentage calculator appears in the Math tools and opens its own page.
behaviors.calculate-percent-of-value: Entering a percentage and a value shows the calculated amount.
behaviors.calculate-value-as-percent: Entering two values shows what percentage the first is of the second.
behaviors.calculate-percentage-change: Entering From and To values shows the percentage increase or decrease.
behaviors.blank-results-for-incomplete-input: A calculation’s result stays blank until both inputs are entered.
behaviors.blank-results-for-zero-denominator: The percentage ratio and percentage change results stay blank when their denominator is zero.

history.notes: The input selectors follow the PR’s data-test-id attributes and end-to-end tests. The opening step assumes the home page shows a Math heading and a link named Percentage calculator.
